incident: Checkout DNS failure caused by stale resolver cache
symptoms: checkout intermittently cannot resolve inventory hostname
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A subset of nodes retained stale DNS resolver state after a service endpoint change.
resolution: Stale resolver state on a subset of nodes caused intermittent dependency lookup failures. Clearing resolver state restored consistency.
postmortem: Application-level restarts did not clear the node resolver cache.
Timeout tuning did not affect DNS lookup.
